subject: Error when deploying shapefile (.shp) to ShinyApps.io

messages.author: 2f6d54521ef2a241
messages.subject: Error when deploying shapefile (.shp) to ShinyApps.io
parts:
When I deployed my .rmd file which reads ArcGIS shapefile. It always gave me error that I could not open the data. 

I have a folder named Dashboard_Model, and in the folder there are .rmd file and all the data files needed and read (including .csv and .shp file with its bundle files). I tried both readOGR and readShapeSpatial to read the shapefile, but it turned out that neither worked. 

When I used readOGR, map <- readOGR(dsn=path.expand("."),layer="TAZ_Polygon"), it showed the error " Error in ogrInfo: Cannot open layer"

When I used readShapeSpatial, map <-  readShapeSpatial("TAZ_Polygon"), it showed the error "Error in getinfo.shape: Error opening SHP file"

I also tried putting the shapefile files into a subfolder (map_file) in the folder Dashboard_Model, using the map <- readOGR(dsn=path.expand("./map_file"),layer="TAZ_Polygon") and map <-  readShapeSpatial("./map_file/TAZ_Polygon"). But it still didn't work. 

Can anyone help me with that?

Thanks!

Iris

messages.subject: Re: Error when deploying shapefile (.shp) to ShinyApps.io
parts:
When you click the deploy button, there are files with checkboxes. Is the shape file checked?

Add code that calls file.exists and uses the same path you are trying to use to load the shape file. If it works, then the file is there and the problem lies with processing its contents. If it does not work, then you are not including in the bundle that is being deployed.
